class.name: YAMLResult
class.brief_description: Contains the results or errors from YAML operations.
class.description: Contains the results from YAML parsing, stringifying, or validation operations, providing a unified interface for both successful data and error cases. This class serves as a return type for API methods, containing either the parsed/stringified data, validation results, or error information. [YAMLResult] objects are immutable and can contain either successful data or error information, but not both. When an operation succeeds, the result contains the data and no error. When an operation fails, the result contains error information and empty data. Multi-document YAML is fully supported, allowing you to access each document individually through [method get_document], and [method get_documents] for all documents. When using [method YAML.parse_and_validate], the result also contains schema validation information accessible through validation-specific methods.

method.name: error
method.description: Creates an error result with the specified error message. Useful for validation when deserializing custom classes (see [method YAML.register_class] for details).

method.name: get_data
method.description: Returns the result data. For multi-document results, returns the first document and logs a warning (use [method get_document] or [method get_documents] instead). Returns [code]null[/code] for error results. If the result contains validation errors, the data may still be returned but should be considered invalid. Check [method has_validation_errors] before using the data.

method.name: get_document
get_document_count
method.description: Returns the number of documents in the result. Returns [code]0[/code] for error results.

method.name: get_documents
get_error
method.description: Returns a formatted error string including message, line number, and column number for parse errors. Returns an empty string if there is no error.

method.name: get_error_column
method.description: Returns the column number where the parse error occurred. Returns [code]-1[/code] if not applicable.

method.name: get_error_line
method.description: Returns the line number where the parse error occurred. Returns [code]-1[/code] if not applicable.

method.name: get_error_message
method.description: Returns the raw error message without line and column information.

method.name: get_style
method.description: Returns the style information if any. Only available if style detection was enabled during parsing (see [method YAML.parse] and [method YAML.load_file]).

method.name: get_validation_error_count
get_validation_errors
method.description:
Returns an array of validation error dictionaries. Each dictionary contains detailed information about a validation failure, including [code]instance_path[/code], [code]message[/code], [code]keyword[/code], and [code]invalid_value[/code] keys.
Returns an empty array if validation passed or if no validation was performed.
This is a convenience method equivalent to calling [code]get_validation_result().get_errors()[/code].
Each error dictionary contains: - [code]message[/code] - Human-readable error description - [code]instance_path[/code] - JSON Pointer to invalid data (e.g., [code]"/user/age"[/code]) - [code]instance_path_array[/code] - Path as array (e.g., [code]["user", "age"][/code]) - [code]schema_path[/code] - Path to schema rule (e.g., [code]"/properties/user/properties/age/minimum"[/code]) - [code]schema_path_array[/code] - Schema path as array - [code]keyword[/code] - Schema constraint that failed (e.g., [code]"minimum"[/code], [code]"type"[/code]) - [code]invalid_value[/code] - The actual value that failed validation
[codeblock] var schema = YAML.load_schema_from_string(""" type: object properties: username: type: string minLength: 3 age: type: integer minimum: 0 required: [username] """)
var result = YAML.parse_and_validate(""" username: "ab" age: -5 """, schema)
if result.has_validation_errors(): for error in result.get_validation_errors(): print("Path: %s" % error.instance_path) print("Constraint: %s" % error.keyword) print("Message: %s" % error.message) print("Invalid value: %s" % error.invalid_value) print("---") [/codeblock]

method.name: get_validation_result
get_validation_summary
has_error
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the result contains a parse or file error, [code]false[/code] otherwise. [b]Note:[/b] This only checks for YAML parsing errors, not validation errors. Use [method has_validation_errors] to check for schema validation failures.

method.name: has_multiple_documents
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the result contains multiple documents, [code]false[/code] otherwise.

method.name: has_style
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the result contains style information, [code]false[/code] otherwise.

method.name: has_validation_errors
method.description:
Returns [code]true[/code] if schema validation was performed and failed with one or more errors, [code]false[/code] if validation passed or no validation was performed. This is a convenience method equivalent to calling [code]has_validation_result() and get_validation_result().has_errors()[/code]. [codeblock lang=gdscript] var result = YAML.parse_and_validate(yaml_text, schema)
# Check both parse errors and validation errors if result.has_error(): push_error("Failed to parse YAML: %s" % result.get_error()) return
if result.has_validation_errors(): push_error("Validation failed:\n%s" % result.get_validation_summary()) return
# Both parsing and validation succeeded var validated_data = result.get_data() use_config(validated_data) [/codeblock]

method.name: has_validation_result
method.description:
Returns [code]true[/code] if this result contains a [SchemaValidationResult], [code]false[/code] otherwise. A validation result is present when using [method YAML.parse_and_validate] or when the parsed YAML includes a [code]$schema[/code] field that references a registered schema. [codeblock lang=gdscript] # Standard parsing - no validation result var result1 = YAML.parse(yaml_text) print(result1.has_validation_result()) # false
# Parse with validation - has validation result var result2 = YAML.parse_and_validate(yaml_text, schema) print(result2.has_validation_result()) # true
# Auto-validation with $schema field var yaml_with_schema = """ $schema: "http://example.com/config.yaml" setting: value """ var result3 = YAML.parse_and_validate(yaml_with_schema) print(result3.has_validation_result()) # true (if schema is registered) [/codeblock]
